name: evaldossier
description: Offline-verifiable evaluation attestations and portable dossiers for heterogeneous AI-agent evaluators.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js demo --out demo-output
scripts.verify:demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js verify demo-output/formal --audience evaldossier.demo.consumer --nonce Zm9ybWFsLWRvc3NpZXItbm9uY2U && node dist/src/cli.js verify demo-output/model-judgment --audience evaldossier.demo.consumer --nonce synthetic-model-judgment-nonce-0001
